Sam (Venturi): Hey team — launching a customer demo targeted to APAC tomorrow 09:00 JST. We need a temporary allowlist + throughput bump on Tokyo edge and a Brazil fallback if Tokyo hits capacity. Can you open these CIDRs and set qps to 1200 for a 12h window? CIDRs: 203.0.113.0/24, 198.51.100.0/27. Also want auto-revoke after window.
Alisha (CS): Thanks Sam — quick Qs: what's the demo duration, expected steady RPS vs burst, and any contract timing we should flag for renewals? I'll note renewal risk if usage spikes.
Sam (Venturi): Demo window is 09:00–21:00 JST. Steady ~600 qps, bursts to ~1200 for ~10–15m every 20m. Renewal is in ~6 weeks — would like usage logged for renewal discussion.
Mike (Network Ops): I can take the CIDR/apply, need official CIDR owner confirmation and a TTL for auto-revoke. Jordan, can you prepare the prod apply and smoke test?
Jordan (Solutions): Will do. Proposed auto-revoke: 12h from start, i.e. auto_revoke=2024-07-12T04:00Z. Draft config below — please confirm before I apply to prod:
```
{"customer":"venturi","cidrs":["203.0.113.0/24","198.51.100.0/27"],"regions":["ap-northeast-1","sa-east-1"],"qps":1200,"duration":"12h","auto_revoke":"2024-07-12T04:00Z"}
```
Alisha (CS): That looks fine. Sam — FYI I'm flagging this in renewal tracking as "engaged" and will collect post-demo feedback. We'll also share the enablement checklist.
Sam (Venturi): Confirmed. Please also capture token spend and any suggestions for reserved capacity ahead of renewal.
quota-bot: Quota request created: +12k tokens/hr for venturi during window. Approve with `/approve quota 1718088888`?
Alisha (CS): Approved. :thumbsup:
Mike (Network Ops): Applying to staging now. Smoke test command: `curl -I https://proxy.tokyo.redwood/health` -> `HTTP/1.1 200 OK`. Scheduling prod cutover at 08:30 JST, will monitor till 10:30 JST.
Jordan (Solutions): Prod config applied at 08:32 JST, canary started 08:40 JST. No errors in first 20m. Routing fallback to sa-east-1 configured at 80% capacity threshold.
Mike (Network Ops): Monitoring dashboards for latency and error-rate. Ping me if p50 > 200ms or error_rate > 0.5%.
Alisha (CS): Noted. I'll open a post-demo feedback session on Monday and add notes about renewal and capacity. Sam, we'll send the enablement doc and warmup checklist now.
Sam (Venturi): Thanks — please share when live. Also request a brief perf snapshot after 1h for internal ops.
Jordan (Solutions): Snapshot will be posted 1h after go-live. Auto-revoke scheduled and will run even if we forget.
quota-bot: Quota change approved and active.
Mike (Network Ops): Prod live at 08:32 JST. Watching until 10:30 JST. Good luck with the demo! :rocket:
